He is playing for the Los Angeles Regional Food Bank(Opens an external site in a new window) CYNTHIA NIXONCynthia Nixon is known for “Sex and the City”, “And Just Like That” and “The Gilded Age.” She is playing for Doctors Without Borders USA(Opens an external site in a new window) IKE BARINHOLTZIke Barinholtz is an actor, writer and director who most recently starred in the Emmy-winning series “The Studio.” He is playing for Noonan Syndrome Foundation(Opens an external site in a new window) JACKIE TOHNJackie Tohn is an actor best known for her role on the hit Netflix series “Nobody Wants This.” She is playing for Kids in the Spotlight(Opens an external site in a new window) KATIE NOLANKatie Nolan is an Emmy-winning sports comedy host now on SiriusXM’s “Fan Service” and her podcast “Casuals.” She is playing for: The Trevor Project(Opens an external site in a new window) LISA ANN WALTERLisa Ann Walter is best known from “The Parent Trap” and as Melissa Schemmenti on ABC’s hit series “Abbott Elementary.” She is playing for the Fund for Women’s Equality(Opens an external site in a new window) MACAULAY CULKINMacaulay Culkin is best known for classics like “Home Alone” and “My Girl.” Now you can catch him on Season 2 of Prime Video’s “Fallout.” He is playing for Stand Up To Cancer(Opens an external site in a new window) MARGARET CHOMargaret Cho is a five-time Grammy and Emmy-nominated comedian and actor who continues to tour North America with her "Choligarchy" comedy show. She is playing for Friendly House(Opens an external site in a new window) MARK DUPLASSMark Duplass is an actor, writer and producer you know from Apple TV’s “The Morning Show” and his indie horror series “The Creep Tapes.” He is playing for The Soul Points Fund(Opens an external site in a new window) MINA KIMESMina Kimes is a journalist, podcaster and NFL analyst at ESPN. She is playing for SELAH Neighborhood Homeless Coalition(Opens an external site in a new window) MIRA SORVINOMira Sorvino is an Academy Award-winning actress and activist. She is playing for the UN Voluntary Trust Fund for Victims of Trafficking in Persons(Opens an external site in a new window) MO ROCCAMo Rocca is an author and correspondent on “CBS Sunday Morning.” He is playing for the Inner-City Scholarship Fund(Opens an external site in a new window) PATTON OSWALTPatton Oswalt is a worldwide headlining comedian and actor you know from “Ratatouille”, “AP Bio”, “The Goldbergs”, “The King of Queens”, and more. He is playing for Alice’s Kids(Opens an external site in a new window) RACHEL DRATCHRachel Dratch was a seven-season cast member on “SNL” and is now the host of the podcast “Woo Woo with Rachel Dratch.” She’s playing for Family Reach(Opens an external site in a new window) RAY ROMANORay Romano is known for “Everybody Loves Raymond” and, most recently, “No Good Deed” on Netflix. He is playing for Harvest Home(Opens an external site in a new window) ROBIN THEDERobin Thede is an actor and comedian who created, wrote, and starred in the HBO Emmy-winning series “A Black Lady Sketch Show.” She is playing fo Black Girls Code(Opens an external site in a new window) ROY WOOD JR.Roy Wood Jr. is the host of CNN’s “Have I Got News for You” and author of the memoir “The Man of Many Fathers.” He is playing for I See Me, Inc.(Opens an external site in a new window) SEAN GUNNSean Gunn is an actor best known for his role as Kirk on “Gilmore Girls” and is currently starring as Maxwell Lord in the DC Comics Universe. Sean is playing for Women for Women International(Opens an external site in a new window) STEVEN WEBERSteven Weber is best known for his role as Brian Hackett on “Wings” and currently as Dr. Archer on “Chicago Med”. He is playing for New Directions for Veterans(Opens an external site in a new window) TIMOTHY SIMONSTimothy Simons is an actor and comedian best known for “Veep” and Netflix’s “Nobody Wants This.” He is playing for Silver Lake Children’s Theatre Group(Opens an external site in a new window) W.
